summary: On a long pull request, checking what’s blocking often means scrolling past dozens of comments and timeline events just to reach the merge box. And once you’re there, you still need to work out what to do next.
takeaways: Explore the supporting signals: A compact view of checks, comments, and approvals keeps the context nearby without making every detail compete for attention.
This first preview also introduces more ways to catch up on activity and focus the conversation so you can spend less time finding your place.
